title: Heracles no Eikou III - Kamigami no Chinmoku
aliases: Heracles no Eikou III: Kamigami no Chinmoku
description: The third game in the RPG series known in the west as Glory of Heracles. It was originally released on the Super Famicom in 1992. It is the most famous entry in the series.
